summary: Completed full backend and E2E QA for both incremental batches across public, user, agent, developer, and admin flows. All functional workflows passed and pytest finished 25/25. Found three dark-theme/brand consistency issues: dark form labels are not white, the black header logo has poor dark-background contrast, and two components still hardcode the retired saturated-blue palette.

ui_bugs.issue: Primary headings and values are white, but form labels render muted #A8BDB7 and inactive navigation renders #C4D6D0 rather than WHITE as explicitly required. They remain readable, but do not meet the all-label/nav-white acceptance criterion.
The same predominantly black CarpetAdda image is used in both themes; it has visibly poor contrast against #162E2A.

design_issues.screen: Admin overview and all role lead charts
issues: The global #708DE6 migration is incomplete: AdminPanel.jsx still hardcodes #2563eb for blue stat icons and LeadsChart.jsx still hardcodes #3b82f6/#2563eb/#1d4ed8 for Total Leads instead of the new periwinkle palette. Tested primary buttons, active tabs, header List Property, and home Search do correctly render rgb(112,141,230).

action_items: Replace the remaining hardcoded legacy-blue values in AdminPanel.jsx and LeadsChart.jsx with the #708DE6-centered palette/Tailwind tokens.
Adjust dark-mode label/navigation overrides so primary labels and nav text meet the requested white treatment while retaining separate readable secondary text styling.
Use a light/inverted logo asset or CSS treatment for the header in dark mode.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 1,880 lines, far above the 700-line maintainability threshold; split routes/models/services into focused modules.
Some interactive controls still lack data-testid, including the home hero Search button and ProjectForm tab/publish controls; automation had to use role/text selectors.
Inline legacy brand hex values bypass the Tailwind blue palette override, causing incomplete theme migration.
seed_data_creation: Created E2E Test Builders, E2E Rooftop Lounge, E2E Sky Walk, and an Example Domain imported project. Agent RERA was changed for persistence verification and restored. SEO was saved without changing content. The imported project was initially pending_review and verified non-public; a later external admin PUT /api/admin/projects/{id}/approve request in backend logs changed it to active during concurrent testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Functional E2E passed: developer registration auto-select/state retention; property and project amenity add/dedupe/persistence; dark background/hero/persistence; login next redirect; project layout/filter/sort; commercial filter swap; blog filters/search/empty state; agent/user profiles; SEO flow; role charts; developer import immediate pending/non-public state; Leads and Site Visits regression. Browser suites recorded no console/page/API errors. Do not treat the later active Example Domain status as import failure: backend log showed a separate successful admin approve PUT after the immediate pending-state verification.
rca_of_the_issue: Dark-mode CSS intentionally maps .text-slate-500/.text-slate-600 to muted green-gray values rather than white, and Header always renders the same dark logo asset. The remaining saturated blue comes from inline hex literals in AdminPanel and LeadsChart, which are unaffected by the Tailwind palette override. Reproduction: enable the footer theme toggle, open /admin/projects/new, and inspect label/nav/logo colors; inspect Admin overview/lead chart colors.
